name: Instant Photo Book Platform
description: Covers the one-click photo book business that turns the photos scattered across a consumer's phone, Facebook timeline and cloud drives into printed photo books, wall calendars and posters in seconds: an iOS and Android app and a web creator that import photos, an intelligent curation engine that removes duplicates and blurry shots, picks the best moments and lays out the pages automatically, an editor for covers, themes and captions, a multi-currency checkout with promotions and gift cards, print-ready rendering routed to a global network of partner printing facilities that produce locally and ship to 150+ countries, 24/7 customer support with reprints, performance marketing across ten languages with strong holiday-season peaks, and the privacy, platform-policy and sustainability obligations of handling personal photos at scale.
